statements: 1 source files declare a package whose text and directory path do not correspond (e.g. directory 'com/rms/unifiedstore/snapshot/common/constants' declares 'package com.rms.unifiedstore.constants'). Any path-to-package inference produces names that match nothing; on a case-insensitive filesystem this is invisible.

75 source files declare a package whose text and directory path differ only in case (e.g. directory 'RMS/UnifiedStore/sqlpool/api/errorhandling' declares 'package rms.unifiedstore.sqlpool.api.errorhandling'). Any path-to-package inference produces names that match nothing; on a case-insensitive filesystem this is invisible.
